description: This file defines the CallSimpleMethod class, which implements the <call-simple-method> element within the Apache OFBiz Mini Language. It handles invoking a specified simple method described in an XML resource, managing scope, result-to-field mappings, and integration with the method execution context.

classes.name: CallSimpleMethod
classes.description: Implements the logic for invoking a simple method defined in an external XML resource, managing scope, results, and artifact gathering.

classes.name: CallSimpleMethod.CallSimpleMethodFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CallSimpleMethod from XML elements.

classes.name: CallSimpleMethod.ResultToField
classes.description: Inner class that maps the result of a simple method call to a field in the environment map.

methods.name: CallSimpleMethod
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on XML element attributes and child elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the simple method call within the given method context, handling scope, errors, and result mapping.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects information about the artifact (simple method XML) for dependency tracking.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the simple method to invoke.

methods.name: getXmlResource
methods.description: Returns the XML resource location where the simple method is defined.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the <call-simple-method> element and its attributes.
